subject: Coord: SOC 2 security deep-dive (encryption, audit logs, SSO) — propose new slots
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@fidelityhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Coord: SOC 2 security deep-dive (encryption, audit logs, SSO) — propose new slots

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time to evaluate Redwood. We'd like to run a focused technical deep-dive for your security and infra teams to cover:
- Encryption at rest + KMS/HSM model (customer-managed keys)
- Audit logging architecture and retention options
- SSO and provisioning (SAML/SCIM) and relevant evidence for SOC 2

Proposed slots (US ET):
- Tue Feb 16, 10:00–11:00 AM ET
- Wed Feb 17, 2:00–3:00 PM ET

If neither works, tell us a couple of windows and we will re-run availability. We can do Zoom + recording. Attendees from our side: me (security/solutions), Aditya (infra/runtime), Priya (compliance/controls).

Attached a short primer that lists the common evidence requests so you have context before the call. If you have a compliance matrix or specific questions (e.g., KMS key rotation policy, HSM attestations), please send them ahead and we will make sure the right folks are on the session.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Solutions Engineer — Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-soc2-evidence-primer.pdf (PDF, 280 KB)

From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@fidelityhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fidelityhealth.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 13:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Coord: SOC 2 security deep-dive (encryption, audit logs, SSO) — propose new slots

Kimberly,

Appreciate the primer. The team is available the week of Feb 22 rather than the 16/17 dates — Q1 sprint cutover is blocking earlier. Can we look at:
- Tue Feb 23, 11:00–12:00 ET
- Thu Feb 25, 3:30–4:30 ET

Also a couple of asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) with Azure Key Vault or AWS KMS + external HSM? We need details on HSM attestation and whether key material ever leaves customer control.
2) Do you have a formal evidence matrix (mapping controls to artifacts) we can use to prep?

I'll attach an internal list of KMS questions so you can route them to the right engineer.

Thanks,
Alex Jensen
Senior Security Manager
Fidelity Health

Attachment: fidelity-kms-questions.pdf (PDF, 95 KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@fidelityhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2027 08:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Coord: SOC 2 security deep-dive (encryption, audit logs, SSO) — propose new slots

Alex — quick note from the infra side. We do support BYOK patterns on both AWS and Azure; for high-assurance customers we can discuss an HSM-backed key wrap flow where the HSM attestation certs are available for review.

For the call, I can cover runtime KMS integration and key lifecycle (rotation, access controls, KMS IAM roles). Priya will walk through the evidence mapping for SOC 2. Kimberly will handle SSO and audit-log retention items.

I can do Tue Feb 23 11:00–12:00 ET — that works for me. Priya, can you confirm the calendar and whether we should send a pre-read?

- Aditya

Hi Alex — thanks, all.

We locked Tue Feb 23, 11:00–12:00 ET. Calendar invite sent (Zoom + recording). Meeting will cover:
- KMS/BYOK patterns (Aditya)
- HSM attestation and key wrapping flow (Aditya + engineering)
- Audit logs: retention, structure, export (Kimberly)
- SSO provisioning, SCIM mapping, and evidence artifacts (Priya)

Pre-reads and artifacts attached: soc2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (control->artifact mapping), network-diagram.pdf (redwood serving topology). Please review the KMS questions you attached and flag any high-priority items so we can prep owners.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=SOC2-meeting
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123soc2

If you need to push to Thu Feb 25, reply and we will reassign owners; for now we are holding Tue 23.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
